# A requirement whose environment marker is split across a backslash line
# continuation. pip joins these into one logical line; parsing physical lines
# would mis-read the marker's leading word ("and") as a package.
pysdl2==0.9 ; python_version >= "3.8" \
    and platform_system == "Linux"

# A hash-pinned requirement continued over several lines (the common case).
# Only the leading package name (foolib) is a dependency; the --hash options
# on the continuation lines are not.
foolib==1.2.3 \
    --hash=sha256:1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111 \
    --hash=sha256:2222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222222

# A plain requirement, no continuation, to anchor the set.
requests==2.31.0
